title: SPEC: board analytics + HTML report — derive views from tasks/events JSONL, define UX (collapse-first), streak semantics
reasoning: SPEC-FIRST TASK (worker writes the spec, then implements in follow-ups). Goal: boardctl renders boards into a static HTML report + optional loopback server so anyone can drop a board folder or zip (multi-board) and see project progress. DATA MODEL (all derivable from tasks.jsonl + events.jsonl + board.jsonl header — no git/repo access needed, uploaded boards must work): (1) task rows: sparse-key tolerant parse, id/title/status/priority/primary_model/commit_hash/reasoning/worker_summary/guard_result/ci_result/attempts/completed_at; fixture rows = id NEVER-DONE* or perpetual:true — EXCLUDED from burndown/velocity/streaks per SCHED-GAP-106 doctrine but visible in task list behind a toggle. (2) event rows: id/timestamp/event_type/task_id/actor/detail/tick_number; tolerant of torn trailing line. (3) timestamps: boards historically use '2006-01-02 15:04:05' AND RFC3339 — parse both. DERIVED VIEWS (each answers a user question): burndown (open tasks/day — backlog shrinking?), burn-up (cumulative completions — velocity, often more honest), weekly velocity bars, cycle time per task (created→done: median, p90, worst-5 table), streaks, tick-health timeline (completed/failed/audit per day), work clock (weekday×hour heatmap), model share over completed tasks, multi-board compare (overlaid burn-up, velocity race, side-by-side key numbers incl. ticks_total/ticks_idle). STREAK SEMANTICS (Bane: what days in a row must not be gameable): DeliveryStreak = consecutive days with >=1 real task completion (headline metric, current+longest); ActivityStreak = days with any non-noise event (current+longest); raw any-tick streak shown only as context, never headline. Render as GitHub-style calendar heatmap (day cells, intensity = event count, last 26 weeks). UX (Bane 163849): 3 layers — overview card grid (per-board mini sparkline + key numbers); project page (charts + task table); task rows COLLAPSED by default showing id/title/status chip/priority/model/commit, click expands in place to full detail (reasoning, worker summary, guard/ci verdicts, attempts, timestamps, last-8 related events, full JSON), expand/collapse-all, filters (text/status/fixtures toggle), expanded row addressable via URL hash. Constraints: single self-contained HTML, inline CSS/JS, NO CDN (works from file://), hand-rolled SVG charts (no libs), JSON island payload with </ escaping. Deliverable for this task: docs/specs/board-analytics-report.md covering data contracts, derivations, view catalog, UX spec, and acceptance criteria for BT-020/021/022.

title: header --set-* on a HEADERLESS board writes header counters INTO the first task row (bit: 9 keys -> 10 on CHT-001)
reasoning:
MEASURED 2026-09-19 while adding the worktree/branch/sessions fields.

REPRO (on a copy, never the live board):
  1. board with tasks.jsonl + events.jsonl and NO board.jsonl (real case: /home/kara/coding-hermes-tools/.coding-hermes/board/).
  2. `boardctl -C <board> header --set-ticks-total 90`
  3. prints: header updated (line 1 of tasks.jsonl): ticks_total, updated_at
  4. RESULT: task CHT-001 (the FIRST task row) grew from 9 keys to 10 -- it now carries ticks_total:90 and a rewritten updated_at. A real task row was silently mutated by a header operation.

ROOT CAUSE: with no board.jsonl the topology detection falls back to 'header = line 1 of tasks.jsonl' and never checks that line 1 is header-SHAPED. Line 1 here is an ordinary task row (id/title/status), so the write lands in a task.

SAME ROOT CAUSE, second symptom: `boardctl validate` on that board reports 3 false errors -- 'tasks.jsonl header: version / ticks_total / ticks_idle is not an integer counter' -- because it validates a task row as a header.

IMPACT: the tool whose entire contract is byte-preserving surgery on non-target rows silently rewrites one. Any headerless board in the fleet is one `header --set-*` away from a corrupted first row.

FIX SHAPE: when board.jsonl is absent, or line 1 carries task keys (id/title/status), classify the board HEADERLESS: (a) `header --set-*` must refuse with an explicit 'no header on this board' error instead of writing; (b) `validate` reports an informational 'headerless board (no board.jsonl)' line rather than integer-counter errors; (c) hard guard -- never write a header key into a row that also carries id/title/status. Tests: a headerless fixture for both paths, plus a RED proof that the guard fires.
worker_summary: header --set-* now refuses on headerless boards (no board.jsonl AND line 1 not header-shaped) with an explicit 'no header on this board' error (ErrNoHeader); validate/doctor emit one informational headerless line and skip the false integer-counter errors; rowIsTaskShape hard guard blocks header keys in any id/title/status row. 17 new tests (bt037_headerless_test.go x10, bt037_headerless_cli_test.go x7), RED-proven by disabling the guards (12 failures with the exact pre-fix symptoms). Foreman live probe on a copy of the real coding-hermes-tools board: header --set-ticks-total 90 -> exit 1, tasks.jsonl sha256 byte-identical, CHT-001 still 9 keys; validate exit 0 with zero false counter errors.
